## Textbook

No textbook is needed. But if you want to buy a book, I recommend @Dar2020. This is a compilation book (I dont create it!) in which chapters are taken from @Croft2006 and @Berenson2012 (Honestly, this is my quickest route of having a book with my name on it). I used this book in the past but realized that students were complaining the book was too thin to put under their pillows.
